questions.text: What would happen if your life and your needs were allowed to take up the very first space in your day?
What is the quietest part of your evening trying to tell you when you sit in that familiar chair?
How might you express regret for how you spoke without erasing the very real exhaustion that caused it?
What would it take to forgive yourself for having a breaking point after carrying so much for so long?
Where do you feel the deepest ache to simply be seen and appreciated for everything you hold?
What could rest look like if you did not have to earn it through endless labor?
Who in your world could you lean on so you no longer have to carry this immense weight completely alone?
